scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.android:sync: npm run build --workspace=client && npx cap sync android && node scripts/normalize-android.mjs
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:sync:local: npm run build:android:local --workspace=client && node scripts/sync-android-local.mjs && node scripts/normalize-android.mjs
scripts.android:open:local: npm run android:sync:local && npx cap open android
